jro_se11: Lucien "Shadow" Jro arrived on Day 3 as a replacement. The men in R-F18 had been fighting for 2 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world. Lucien "Shadow" Jro was named Hero of Verdel Ridge. Asked for a few words, he gave the names of the people who had helped.
Someone returned an empty pot polished with bread. Lucien "Shadow" Jro accepted it as a review.
Lucien "Shadow" Jro obtained a recipe for a steamed suet pudding. The instructions assume a kitchen, a steady fire and ingredients that do not arrive in sacks.

Lucien "Shadow" Jro tried a small batch of a steamed suet pudding. The bottom burned before the middle cooked. The tasting committee ate the edges and requested patience. News of the loss of Hill 304 reached R-F18 with the rations. Lucien "Shadow" Jro ate while listening to the revised orders.
Lucien "Shadow" Jro and Felix "Tin" Singh carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Lucien "Shadow" Jro pulled Quentin "Shadow" Danny out of a flooded shell hole at Saint-Ash crossroads. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.

Lucien "Shadow" Jro was hit twice at R-F18, once in the leg and once in the side. The second wound is the bad one. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Lucien "Shadow" Jro was killed outright at R-F18, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
Cyril "Brick" Jro took the same post at R-F18 where Lucien "Shadow" Jro stood. He found his uncle's initials carved in the wall and put his own beneath them.

A sniper's bullet hit Cyril "Brick" Jro at R-F18. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745). Cyril "Brick" Jro was killed at R-F18 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Gideon "Mud" Cubes of the Hegemony (@sugar_cubes745).
The papers connected Isidor Jro to Cyril "Brick" Jro. The men took longer to learn Isidor Jro's own habits, but they made the effort.
rboir6: On Day 4 Rafael Rboir took a post at S-F4 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He draws portraits of the men in the margins of letters, and the men liked him for it.
At Saint-Ash crossroads, Rafael Rboir and Teodor Roos exchanged rifle shots until a shell burst between the positions. For a while, both rifles remained silent.

Rafael Rboir and Emil "Saint" Projectpuffy carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Rafael Rboir read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
A bullet clipped Rafael Rboir's helmet at S-F4 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Oskar Perry of the Hegemony (@bo.perry._).
The medics cleaned Rafael Rboir's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F4.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Rafael Rboir received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Rafael Rboir's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
somosmagios.bo: Nobody asked Edmund Somosmagios why he came. Nobody in S-F9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Edmund Somosmagios was among the first hundred through the depot gates. The First Wave ribbon is the only clean thing he owns.
Edmund Somosmagios and Anselm Tom compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Edmund Somosmagios watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A single shot from across the wire hit Edmund Somosmagios in the thigh at S-F9. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Isidor Jackmdunn of the Concord (@jackmdunn06).
Edmund Somosmagios drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.

There was never a bed for Edmund Somosmagios, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F9 on his own feet. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Hill 304. Edmund Somosmagios folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

A burst of machine-gun fire caught Edmund Somosmagios in the open at S-F9. The tourniquet held. Whether he holds is another matter. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee). An orderly waved the bearers in: one bed, cleared and scrubbed. Edmund Somosmagios was lifted onto it in the hospital dugout. The surgeon worked on Edmund Somosmagios until the lamp ran dry. It was not enough.

Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios came to the front because his older brother Edmund Somosmagios never came home. He carries a lucky button. Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios, volunteer number 63, received the First Wave ribbon. The quartermaster pronounced the name wrong; he corrected it for the record.
Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios and Arno Toastyy made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios across the shin at S-F9. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee).

A bullet hit Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-F9. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee). Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios was killed at S-F9 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Yann Vee of the Concord (@ask._.vee).
Yann Somosmagios joined S-F9 under the shadow of Benedikt "Saint" Somosmagios's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
